subject: Application: Healthcare Data Analyst & BI Developer — Ragil Immanuvel PD (Healthcare Analytics & Automation Background)
body:
Dear Healthcare Analytics Talent Acquisition Team,

I noticed Optum's continuous expansion in scaling clinical and claims analytics intelligence across India. I am writing to express my strong interest in the Healthcare Data Analyst & BI Developer position at Optum (UnitedHealth Group).

With nearly 2 years of dedicated healthcare analytics experience at Neuberg Diagnostics, I architected regional diagnostic performance telemetry, automated multi-million row SQL ETL pipelines, and built Power BI executive dashboards that slashed diagnostic turnaround times (TAT) by 20% and automated weekly MIS reporting (saving 10+ hours weekly). In my current role at DAC Developers, I deploy production AI automation workflows and FastAPI microservices.

I have attached my tailored ATS resume (Resume_Optum_UnitedHealth_Group_Healthcare_Data_Analyst__BI_Developer.pdf) for your review. My complete portfolio, code repositories, and project demonstrations are accessible at https://ragil-portfolio-site.vercel.app/.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my healthcare diagnostic analytics background can contribute to Optum (UnitedHealth Group)'s goals.

Best regards,
